The EP itself entered the UK Top 40, marking an early moment of IDM crossing into mainstream chart visibility.

38RMZ9H7Cg8.sig: A landmark in IDM music video aesthetics, 'On' established a visual grammar of abstraction, craft-based surrealism, and deliberate anti-spectacle that anticipated later Warp video work.
